groups.contract: Character export retains body/equipment morph correspondence and material ownership through one assembled result
groups.disposition: Whole body read. Generated body, morphs, selected armor, lower lining and cloth shells are computed before export_rigged_glb. piece_geometry is an unzip over actual armor vector, yielding matching faces/targets vector lengths, so catalog_shells indices i are established by construction for plates and lacing, even when optional lacing has empty slot. Distinct metals are baked once using exact Metal equality; matching trim absence errors rather than fabricating a material. Normal/UV/material roles remain separate, including component-specific material overrides and lacing nonmetallic finish. Zips rely on each owning morph producer returning one row per shell/garment, an explicit upstream aggregate dependency, not established by zip itself. mail_surfaces uses checked loadout.draped.get(index); correspondence assumes actual completed drape prefix order, not an arbitrary unordered externally supplied fitted slice. Actual garment-outcome/continuation owner remains upcoming. No malformed ordinary export or output write behavior inferred without the actual export owner.

groups.contract: Undrapable garments and fit warnings have explicit retained export policy, with native collision topology obligations
groups.disposition: Both full bodies read. prepare borrows provided fitted garments or computes drape_outfit, preserves problems and reports missing count via saturating_sub. Saturation is deliberate diagnostic count, not proof supplied extra garments are valid. Fit/body/self clearance failures become warning strings and do not cancel export, matching actual documentation316; no accidental error-erasure finding is claimed for this explicit authoring policy. Validation concatenates actual body then each garment with source-index offsets for collision; native u32 capacity/index relationships require accepted actual mesh, no multi-billion-vertex witness. Ignored chainmail fixture requires exact cached body match before using garment rows, re-transfers skin before export and checks actual glTF material alpha/metallic/normal/color roles. Its old LOD1 asset request differs from documented supported4-6; it is an ignored historical fixture, not proof normal export fails or current passing test. No file write/GPU/GLB execution performed.

groups.contract: Hair export owns body-specific placement, repeated head skin and actual atlas image dimensions
groups.disposition: Whole body read. Headless GPU OnceLock retains either actual device or explicit error; subsequent calls report retained initialization failure rather than claim automatic retry. Hair grow/place and geometry/morph operations propagate Results before constructing ExportedHair. Whole_joint gives exactly1 head weight and repeated validates actual head ordinal against generated rig count; every vertex gets same row. First atlas level is checked, fixed4-channel shade/coverage maps pigment through sRGB and PNG encoder receives exact dimensions; any rgba remainder is silently omitted by as_chunks, so actual atlas buffer extent/coherence remains HairGpu owner obligation, not assumed solely from metadata. Constant1x1 flat normal is intrinsic valid image. Cards form0 and omitted scalp are explicit export policy. No production asset/render acceptance or GPU timing claim.
